description: Placeholder starter bindings for multi-reference (R2V) audio-locked lip-sync workflows (e.g. Wan VACE/Phantom, LTX-2.x AV Audio-Lock, or licensed MiniMax H3 Audio-Lock). Receives the shot's starting still ('image'), isolated vocal slice ('audio'), and optional character/scene reference images ('reference_image', 'reference_image_2', 'set_image') whose LoadImage nodes are pruned automatically on shots without them. Replace example node ids with ids from your exported ComfyUI API workflow.
